en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a small rural village with a dirt road leading into a cluster of houses and buildings. There are some trees along the road, and the buildings appear to be typical European rural architecture from the late 19th or early 20th century. The text 'Gruss aus Gauernitz.' is prominently displayed in red on the lower right. Some additional text is visible on the left and on one of the buildings.
